svg.title: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · calibrated-timeout diagnostics
svg.desc: Unequal-work timeout diagnostics showing paired row, wire-byte, and protocol-specific timeout-evidence deltas; no throughput or latency comparison.
svg.text: MOD-17473 · Native OSS cluster · calibrated-timeout diagnostics
Unequal returned work: descriptive PR − baseline paired medians only. No RPS or latency effect is shown or implied.
Per case: 10 baseline/PR pairs = 20 fresh two-primary topology observations = 40 Redis process executions.
This figure: 60 pairs / 120 topology observations / 240 Redis processes. Whole campaign: 180 pairs / 360 topology observations / 720 Redis processes.
paired effect + 95% order-stratified whole-pair bootstrap CI
Rows returned per reply · PR − baseline
Wire reply size per reply · PR − baseline
Timeout evidence (RESP2 partial reply; RESP3 timeout-warning reply) · PR − baseline
6 baseline-only calibration topology starts / 12 Redis processes / 78 timeout-budget probe client invocations are excluded from N. CIs use 10,000 order-stratified whole-pair resamples.
